title: Managed Backup: independent resource scopes
content:
For Managed Backup, the independent resource scopes basis governs contract application registration.

## Policy clauses

The signed resource scope is not already represented by a nonclosed contract.

Multiple independent resource scopes may be held.

Use external source reference as the signed resource-scope key.

Count all nonclosed holdings of this category for the same customer; refuse creation if the count would exceed 24.

A repeated signed application with the same external resource scope reuses the existing contract rather than opening another.

## Authoritative evidence

Before contract application registration, system records must establish this condition for the proposed action: The signed resource scope is not already represented by a nonclosed contract.

The evidence identifies Contract reference, Customer reference, Status, External source reference. Match the action to that evidence by Contract reference, Customer reference; these references identify the same proposed business objects.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the stated entry basis?** The signed resource scope is not already represented by a nonclosed contract.

## Hypothetical case

A hypothetical customer has 24 nonclosed contracts and proposes a new independent scope. Creation would exceed the permitted count and is refused. A repeated signed application for an existing scope instead reuses its contract.
